name: @pipeworx/mcp-db-rail

tools.name: dbrail_locations
tools.description: Search German / European rail stations, stops, and places by name (e.g. "Berlin Hbf", "München", "Zürich HB"). Returns matches with a stop id, coordinates, and country. Keyless. You do NOT have to call this first — dbrail_departures, dbrail_arrivals and dbrail_journeys all accept a plain station name and resolve it themselves; use this when you want to disambiguate between similarly-named stations or need coordinates.

tools.name: dbrail_departures
tools.description: Live departures board for a German / European station. Pass a station NAME ("Berlin Hbf") or a stop id from dbrail_locations. Returns upcoming departures with line/train number, destination, scheduled and real-time departure, delay in minutes, platform/track, and operator. Keyless, real-time where the operator publishes it.

id.description: Station name ("Berlin Hbf") or stop id from dbrail_locations.

when.description: ISO date/time to start the board from (e.g. "2026-07-25T18:00:00Z"). Defaults to now.

mode.description: Filter by transport mode. Pass "rail" for trains only (high-speed, long-distance, night, regional) — recommended at big stations, where trams/buses otherwise dominate the board. Or pass explicit MOTIS modes, comma-separated: HIGHSPEED_RAIL, LONG_DISTANCE, REGIONAL_RAIL, SUBURBAN, SUBWAY, TRAM, BUS, COACH, FERRY.

tools.name: dbrail_arrivals
tools.description: Live arrivals board for a German / European station. Pass a station NAME ("München Hbf") or a stop id from dbrail_locations. Returns upcoming arrivals with line/train number, origin, scheduled and real-time arrival, delay in minutes, platform/track, and operator. Keyless, real-time where the operator publishes it.

id.description: Station name ("München Hbf") or stop id from dbrail_locations.

when.description: ISO date/time to start the board from. Defaults to now.

mode.description: Filter by transport mode. Pass "rail" for trains only (high-speed, long-distance, night, regional) — recommended at big stations, where trams/buses otherwise dominate the board. Or pass explicit MOTIS modes, comma-separated: HIGHSPEED_RAIL, LONG_DISTANCE, REGIONAL_RAIL, SUBURBAN, SUBWAY, TRAM, BUS, COACH, FERRY.

tools.name: dbrail_journeys
tools.description: Plan a multi-leg rail / public-transport journey between two places in Europe. Pass station NAMES ("Berlin Hbf" -> "München Hbf") or stop ids. Returns route options, each with total duration, number of transfers, and every leg (mode, line, from/to with platforms, scheduled + real-time times). Keyless.

from.description: Origin station name or stop id, e.g. "Berlin Hbf".

to.description: Destination station name or stop id, e.g. "München Hbf".

departure.description: ISO date/time to depart at (e.g. "2026-07-25T18:00:00Z"). Defaults to now.

results.description: Max journey options to return (default 3, max 6).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-db-rail forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the db-rail pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
